short_name.notes: Used as institutional abbreviation in OzU fact sheet URLs and text.

min_gpa_host.notes: No host incoming exchange minimum GPA stated in AY 2025-2026 fact sheet.

english_course_availability.notes: Primary medium of instruction across most undergraduate programmes is English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 English required (TOEFL iBT 80 or home-institution letter; IELTS is NOT accepted per Turkish CoHE regulation; exempt for native speakers or students at fully English-taught partner universities).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Confirm AUC English-medium certificate acceptance with OzU.

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught courses; optional 4-ECTS Turkish for Foreigners course available.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026 Fall: Recommended arrival Sep 15, 2025 (semester dates per academic calendar).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026 Spring: Recommended arrival Feb 2, 2026 (semester dates per academic calendar).

tuition_model.notes: Tuition and registration fees are waived for incoming exchange students.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2025-2026 fact sheet p.5 quotes official monthly living cost estimate in EUR (EUR 600-700/month, incl. rent EUR 450-650); local Turkish currency is TRY.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from EUR 600-700/month (EUR 650/mo) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); math: 650 * 5 * 1.1052 = 3591.90 USD (approx. USD 3592).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory valid health insurance required (EHIC is NOT valid in Türkiye); one-time EUR 20 residence permit card fee; tuition and registration fees waived.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Tuition/reg fee waiver on p.3; insurance & EUR 20 fee on p.5.

housing_availability.notes: Fact sheet p.4 states all registered students may live in on-campus dormitories by signing the binding housing agreement; dormitory deposit waived for exchange students.

housing_notes.value: On-campus Çekmeköy dormitories available upon signing binding housing agreement (deposit waived for exchange students); estimated rent EUR 450-650/month.
housing_notes.notes: Dorm policy p.4; rent range p.5.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Turkish student visa processing takes 6-8 weeks before departure; mandatory Turkish Residence Permit application required upon arrival (EUR 20 fee); financial proof threshold not specified.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: 6-8 week visa lead time on p.4; EUR 20 fee on p.5.

english_course_list_url.notes: Dynamic ECTS Courses Offered portal; primary instruction language across undergraduate programmes is English.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; regular load 30 ECTS/semester (maximum 36 ECTS).

course_restrictions_note.value: AUC agreement covers Undergraduate (UG) level only per Excel.

academic_style.value: US letter grading scale (minimum passing grade D for UG, C for GR); English-medium campus in Çekmeköy, Istanbul.

city_tier.notes: Istanbul is Turkey's largest metropolis, Çekmeköy campus is on the Asian side; schema city_tier label not explicitly classified in fact sheet.

campus_type.notes: Çekmeköy campus in Istanbul; schema campus_type category not explicitly specified in fact sheet.

international_support_services.value: IEPP international exchange office, optional 4-ECTS Turkish for Foreigners course, residence permit guidance, and on-campus sports facilities.
international_support_services.notes: Turkish course on p.3; IEPP/permit guidance on p.4.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2025-2026: Fall application Jul 16 (nominations ~1 month prior); Spring application Dec 1 (nominations ~1 month prior).
